unit.why: A short anecdote: after the deaths of R. Zvi and then his brother R. Berish, the hasidim come to R. Moshe with excuses, and he answers them humbly.

stories.start_quote: אחרי פטירת אחיו רבינו צבי בי"א
stories.end_quote: פאר וואס איהר זענט ביז אצונד נישט גיקומין
stories.summary_en: After R. Zvi of Zhidachov died, many hasidim went to his brother R. Berish; when Berish died ten months later they came to R. Moshe, each giving an excuse for not coming sooner, and he humbly replied that it was enough that he did not ask why they came now, let alone why they had not come until now.

quotes: והוא זה האיש משה רבינו בענוות רוחו
